title: 享樂之後，還得算帳
titleEn: After the Feast Comes the Reckoning
imageAlt: Illustrated learning card for After the Feast Comes the Reckoning.
imageAltZh: 「享樂之後，還得算帳」學習插圖。

source.reference: Oxford proverb index; original teaching scenes and questions

meaning.en: A period of pleasure or indulgence may be followed by a cost or consequence.
meaning.zh: 享樂或放縱過後，仍可能要面對開支、責任或其他後果。

formulas.formula: after the feast comes the reckoning
formulas.highlight: after the feast comes the reckoning

examples.en: The party was wonderful, but the next day the group faced the overspent budget—after the feast comes the reckoning.
examples.zh: 派對辦得盡興，第二天大家才整理超支的帳目。
examples.highlight: after the feast comes the reckoning

instructions.zh: 選出唯一保留情境事實、又正確使用「after the feast comes the reckoning」的英文句子。
